title: Verhältnis zum Logo
slide_intent: Set a proportional range so the supporting element does not overwhelm the identity mark.
strategic_value: A bounded relationship can keep DB’s logo and Schwelle visually balanced.
demonstration: Three red sequences are compared with pale logo references at half, two-thirds and full logo height.
practical_value: Use approximately two-thirds as guidance while staying between half and full logo height.

content_islands.name: Proportion guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation above the diagram.

content_islands.name: Size comparison
content_islands.spec: Stack the minimum, recommended and maximum sequence sizes beside logo references and labels.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text connects proportion choices to harmonious balance among logo, Schwelle and layout.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Half logo height is the minimum and full logo height the maximum; two-thirds is a flexible recommended value.
reference_purposes.Application: The three labeled specimens distinguish a recommendation from limits.

ingredient.name: Schwelle-to-logo height
ingredient.role: Balance the supporting bars with the primary mark.
ingredient.application: Aim for approximately two-thirds logo height; keep within one-half to one full logo height.
ingredient.scope: Official DB new-design website captured 2026-11-05; edition date unstated. Two-thirds is guidance, not a fixed requirement.
